applicability: CORE or Marketplace Portal accounts with the corresponding optional product records, service profile 4.1.0. Existing base product rules apply alongside these additional terms.
content:
A phone update changes contact facts and security version after review. It does not change the recorded recovery owner. A delegate adoption requires current SMS verification and explicitly transfers recovery control. Staff inventory, phone records and authentication evidence have distinct purposes.

Detailed local effects and operation names: `RST-delegates`.

provenance.source: Primary-author synthetic extension of the frozen 4.0.2 business mechanisms; no claim of a verbatim source SOP rule.
